# funnel_custom_metric (Resource)

Manages a custom metric in a Funnel workspace. Rules in `derived` are easiest to build in the Funnel UI. Import the metric afterwards, or copy it to other workspaces with the `funnel_custom_metric` data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Number type custom metric with SUM aggregation
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "total_leads" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Total Leads"
  description = "Sum of all leads generated across campaigns"
  unit        = "number"
  aggregation = "SUM"
  precision   = 0
}

# Monetary type custom metric with precision
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "revenue_per_click" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Revenue Per Click"
  description = "Average revenue generated per click"
  unit        = "monetary"
  aggregation = "NONE"
  precision   = 2
}

# Percent type custom metric
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "conversion_rate" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Conversion Rate"
  description = "Percentage of visitors who convert"
  unit        = "percent"
  aggregation = "NONE"
  precision   = 2
}

# Duration type custom metric with MAX aggregation
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "max_session_duration" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Maximum Session Duration"
  description = "Longest user session duration in seconds"
  unit        = "duration"
  aggregation = "MAX"
  precision   = 0
}

# COUNT aggregation example
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "unique_campaigns" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Unique Campaign Count"
  description = "Count of unique campaigns"
  unit        = "number"
  aggregation = "COUNT"
  precision   = 0
}

# Metric with rules, here copied from the Funnel UI. Built-in field IDs like "adwords-conversions" work in any workspace.
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "conversions_by_source" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Conversions By Source"
  description = "Google Ads conversions for Google Ads, regular conversions for everything else"
  unit        = "number"
  aggregation = "SUM"
  derived = jsonencode({
    expr = {
      "=case" = [
        {
          "=when" = { sourceType = { "=eq" = "adwords" } }
          "=then" = {
            "=case" = [{
              "=when" = true
              "=then" = { "=value" = [{ "=get" = "adwords-conversions" }] }
            }]
          }
        },
        {
          "=when" = true
          "=then" = {
            "=case" = [{
              "=when" = true
              "=then" = { "=value" = [{ "=get" = "conversions" }] }
            }]
          }
        },
      ]
    }
  })
}

# Rules exported from the Funnel UI and kept in a file
resource "funnel_custom_metric" "from_file" {
  workspace   = var.workspace_id
  name        = "Blended Conversions"
  description = "Rules maintained in the Funnel UI"
  unit        = "number"
  aggregation = "SUM"
  derived     = file("${path.module}/blended_conversions.json")
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `aggregation` (String) Custom metric aggregation type. One of `SUM`, `COUNT`, `MIN`, `MAX`, or `NONE`.
- `description` (String) Custom metric description. Will be displayed in the Funnel UI.
- `name` (String) Custom metric name
- `unit` (String) Custom metric unit type. One of `number`, `percent`, `monetary`, or `duration`.
- `workspace` (String) Funnel workspace ID. Must be exactly 20 characters (letters, digits, `-` and `_`).

### Optional

- `derived` (String) JSON-encoded rules for how the metric is calculated, in Funnel's expression format. Easiest to build in the Funnel UI, then import the metric or copy it with the `funnel_custom_metric` data source. `=case` branches are evaluated in order. Built-in field IDs work in any workspace, but references to custom fields should use the field's Terraform `id`.
- `precision` (Number) Custom metric precision. Defines how many decimal places to show. One of `0`, `1`, `2`, `3`, or `4`. Default is 0.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Custom metric ID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Import a metric set up in the Funnel UI. Run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf` to have Terraform write its configuration, including `derived`.
import {
  to = funnel_custom_metric.example
  id = "<workspace_id>/<custom_metric_id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import funnel_custom_metric.example <workspace_id>/<custom_metric_id>
```
